market_summary: During the late New York session, monitored assets are consolidating in low-volume, mid-channel ranges following earlier volatility. Metals and FX remain suppressed below their session VWAPs and either inside or beneath their Value Areas with sub-1.0 RVOL. US100 trades inside its Value Area in a negative GEX regime but sits just above major structural support at VWAP and Put Wall #2. BTCUSD remains compressed in a narrow range above session lows. With no volume-backed breakouts or clean sweeps across the board, disciplined risk management dictates HOLD across all six symbols.
